subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster pair.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) CE-FH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b5933478e2c8835e311236af1b65f92b9284443942266bb0be4a7b129d50a42.png] 

Option 2) SU-VX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57c79c1a380ae7a8f2bc7e12951c148a8dcae333fa65cb191f26823541847734.png] 

Option 3) **KM-NO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53a8acb91907d54f37a23d340c13d758bfe978ee88f6bdad7f859fe1949b9ab3.png] 

Option 4)AC-DF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed193387e92c44df6ce1c8c87925c6a3188f3b9bf4c1dbc1ca54735d90ce6c81.png] 

Here, 'KM-NO' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
